text: Chapter 12: The Weredragons' Vital Point@Cocoon in the Ice Wall
■Next Mission\nStart from Boma Konda: Village Center.
The dragons serving as the Imperial Dragon's minions seem to\nbe trying to destroy the royal dragon cocoon to make him the\nruler of the world. First, go to Algid Passage to stop it!
After making your way through Algid Passage, you find\nyourself in an area surrounded by walls of ice.\nBe careful of the roaming monsters and continue ahead!
According to the village chief's story, the royal dragon\ncocoon is at the Frozen Falls. Eliminate the Coenubias and\nhead towards the depths!
You've reached the location of the royal dragon cocoon, but\na brass dragon is being taken over by the Coenubias.\nJoin forces with the Knight of Thorns to defeat Dominaredor!
